properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated July 22, [1947], on stationery from the Imperial Hotel in Tokyo; includes brief description of meeting with General Douglas A. MacArthur as well as impressions of Tokyo; mentions Bill Branch, Lieutenant General Whitehead, and Colonel Johnson.
